source: a single man in possession of a good fortune
lost: The generic reading (the typical such man, as a kind) can only be written as ALL, which turns a generalisation into an exceptionless universal claim.
fix: Add a quantifier GENERIC (kind-level, tolerates exceptions) beside ALL/SOME/NO.

source: must be in want of a wife
lost: The necessity modal 'must' has no slot; strength CERTAIN says how sure the writer is, not that the thing is required or bound to be so.
fix: Add a modality slot after aspect with MUST, CAN, MAY (necessity, ability/possibility, permission).

source: It is a truth universally acknowledged
lost: The sentence is ironic (the narrator does not endorse the 'truth'), but the encoding states it as a plain RECALLED fact.
fix: Add attitude IRONY (writer does not mean the literal claim).

source: However little known the feelings or views ... may be
lost: The 'no matter how little' meaning (concession across every degree) is reduced to a flat 'possibly not known'.
fix: Allow WHAT in a degree position inside a conceded sentence (CONCEDE + degree WHAT = 'however much'), once a degree slot exists.

source: the feelings or views
lost: Two joined nouns cannot share one phrase, so the whole sentence is written twice (sentences 2 and 3).
fix: Add phrase-level joiners AND / OR between phrases under one role: THEME feeling AND view.

source: so well fixed ... that he is considered
lost: The 'so much that' link between a degree and its consequence is split into a bare statement plus RESULT, losing that it is the extent of fixedness that produces the result.
fix: Add degree particles (VERY, SLIGHT, TOO, ENOUGH, SO) before a predicate or modifier; SO pairs with a RESULT sentence.

source: on his first entering a neighbourhood
lost: 'The first time' is written as manner 'WITH first', which is not clearly an ordinal over occasions.
fix: Allow ordinals as quantifiers (ORDINAL n before a head or clause).

source: some one or other of their daughters
lost: 'One, it does not matter which' is flattened to the number 1, which could be read as one particular daughter.
fix: Add quantifier ANY (free choice) distinct from SOME.

source: My dear Mr. Bennet,
lost: Direct address and the term of endearment are dropped; the addressee survives only as a TO role on 'ask'.
fix: Add a role CALL for a vocative phrase, which may carry modifiers (CALL name«Bennet» KIND dear).

source: "have you heard that Netherfield Park is let at last?"
lost: Direct speech becomes indirect: the speaker's own 'I/you/here' must be rewritten as handles because ME/YOU always mean the writer and reader.
fix: Add a quote block (QUOTE speaker { ... }) inside which ME/YOU/now shift to the quoted speaker and which may hold full sentences with openers.

source: have you heard ...?
lost: A quoted question cannot be marked as a question because openers are barred inside { }; it rests entirely on choosing the content root 'ask'.
fix: Let a block optionally start with an opener/relation/strength/attitude when it is the THEME of a speech or thought predicate.

source: is let at last
lost: 'At last' (it happened after a long wait, and was hoped for) has no marker.
fix: Add phase particles in the aspect slot: ALREADY, STILL, FINALLY, NOT-YET (or STILL + NOT).

source: "But it is,"
lost: The contrast and the insistence belong to the wife's words, but CONTRAST/EMPHASIS can only mark the narrator's sentence, so the narrator seems to be the one contrasting.
fix: Same as above: allow relation and attitude markers at the head of a quoted block.

source: for Mrs. Long has just been here
lost: 'For' gives her evidence for the claim, not the cause of the house being let; CAUSE inside the block would say the wrong thing, so the link is reduced to ADD.
fix: Add relation EVIDENCE (this sentence is the speaker's ground for the target) distinct from the CAUSE role.

source: has just been here
lost: 'Just' (a moment ago) is lost; PAST DONE gives no distance in time.
fix: Add time-distance particles NEAR / FAR usable with PAST and FUTURE (PAST NEAR = just now).

source: told me all about it
lost: There is no 'about' role, so the topic of telling needs a relative clause with a helper root (fact KIND { concern ... }).
fix: Add role ABOUT (topic of speech, thought or feeling).

source: Do not you want to know
lost: A negative question expecting 'yes' is indistinguishable from a neutral question about a negative fact.
fix: Allow strength on ASK to show the expected answer (ASK LIKELY p = 'p, isn't it?').

source: know who has taken it
lost: WHAT inside an embedded clause cannot be told apart from WHAT that makes the whole sentence a question; in sentence 13 a statement containing WHAT looks like a question.
fix: State that WHAT is a question only directly under ASK; add WHICHEVER (or a block prefix ASK) for embedded questions.

source: _You_ want to tell me
lost: Contrastive stress ('you are the one who wants this') is only approximated by INSTEAD, which implies a stated alternative that the text never gives.
fix: Add a plain focus particle FOCUS (this constituent is the point) to the focus list.

source: I have no objection to hearing it
lost: The dry understatement (grudging permission standing in for interest) reads as a literal report of having no objection.
fix: Covered by the proposed IRONY attitude if allowed inside quoted blocks; otherwise none.

source: said his lady to him one day
lost: Every sentence needs an evidence opener, and none fits fictional narration; GIVEN falsely presents the story as observed or documented.
fix: Add opener TELL (narration or the writer's own first-hand assertion, with no evidence claim).

source: much obliged ... very agreeable ... very good-natured ... so long a letter ... most heartily
lost: Every degree word is dropped; one sentence-wide EMPHASIS cannot say which quality is intensified or by how much.
fix: Degree particles (VERY, SLIGHT, TOO, ENOUGH, MOST) placed before the predicate or modifier they grade.

source: in the midst of your scientific and theatrical dissipation
lost: The phrase means 'although you were so busy enjoying yourself', but WHEN gives only the time; a role phrase cannot carry concession.
fix: Add role DESPITE (a circumstance that would have been expected to prevent the event).

source: scientific and theatrical
lost: Stacked KIND modifiers read as one thing that is both scientific and theatrical, not two sorts of activity.
fix: Phrase-level AND between modifiers: KIND (scientific AND theatrical).

source: I must condole with you
lost: 'Must' as felt obligation is dropped.
fix: MUST in the proposed modality slot.

source: your PRESENT view ... for MYSELF
lost: Stress on one word (hinting the view may change; setting 'for myself' against 'for you') cannot be placed: EMPHASIS covers the whole sentence and the four focus particles mean other things.
fix: Plain FOCUS particle before the stressed constituent.

source: (Sir J.D. Hooker was a candidate for the Professorship of Botany at Edinburgh University.)
lost: The parenthesis is an editor's note, not the letter-writer's words; BACKGROUND keeps it as an aside but the change of voice is invisible.
fix: Define the unused 'cites' slot as a source marker: BY handle/name after the opener (GIVEN BY editor ...).

source: There is something so chilling in
lost: The hedge 'something ... in it' (partly, in some respect) becomes the flat claim that the separation is chilling.
fix: Add an approximator ROUGHLY usable before a predicate, modifier or number.

source: so many hundred miles
lost: A vague large quantity ('several hundred') has no form; quantifiers are only ALL, SOME, NO or an exact number.
fix: Add quantifiers MANY, FEW, MOST and let ROUGHLY precede a number (ROUGHLY 300 mile).

source: we did not see ... during our lives
lost: There is no 'we' and no way to join ME and YOU as one participant, so the writer alone is made the subject.
fix: Phrase-level AND (ME AND YOU), optionally NAMED a handle; or add a pronoun US.

source: each other
lost: Reciprocal action is written one-way (I see you).
fix: Add head MUTUAL, parallel to SELF, for a reciprocal THEME (see AGENT G THEME MUTUAL).

source: did not see much of each other
lost: NOT negates the whole clause, so 'not often' and 'often not' (or 'never') cannot be told apart.
fix: Allow NOT before a phrase or modifier as well as before the clause (WITH NOT frequent).

source: You will hardly believe
lost: 'Hardly' (almost not) is turned into 'likely not', which is a different claim.
fix: Degree particle BARELY (also covers 'almost' with NOT).

source: how deeply I regret
lost: An embedded 'how much' has no form; it needs a second sentence pointing at 'the depth of step 9'.
fix: Allow WHAT/WHICHEVER in the degree slot of an embedded clause.

source: I had looked forward to [our] seeing
lost: Past-before-past, with the hint that the hope is now defeated, is only PAST DONE; and FUTURE inside the block does not say whether it is future from then or from now.
fix: Add relative-time particles BEFORE / AFTER (relative to the containing clause) usable in the time slot of a block.

source: during our lives
lost: WHEN marks a point in time; 'throughout' a span is not distinguished.
fix: Add role SPAN (duration or extent: time, distance, amount).

source: in a mere selfish point of view
lost: A viewpoint restriction ('judged from this angle') has no role; WITH (means/manner) misstates it as the manner of being irreparable.
fix: Add role AS (capacity, respect or viewpoint under which the claim holds).

source: as aiding me in my work
lost: 'In your capacity as my helper' has to be faked with a restrictive clause on YOU, which wrongly suggests there are several 'you's.
fix: Same role AS.

source: I am much obliged ... I must condole with you
lost: Thanking and condoling are acts performed by the words, but the only fitting opener (GIVEN) reports them as observed facts.
fix: Add opener EXPRESS (thanks, apology, greeting, condolence, wish).

source: No Person shall be ... who shall not
lost: The clause lays down a rule (prohibition), but there is no deontic marker and no rule-making opener, so it decodes as a description: 'if not 25, the person is not a representative'.
fix: MUST/MAY in the modality slot plus an opener RULE (the sentence enacts or states a norm).

source: who shall not have attained ..., and been ..., and who shall not ... be
lost: A negated three-part list under 'no person' cannot be written directly; it must be turned by hand into nested two-way OR blocks inside IF, six braces deep.
fix: Let AND / OR join any number of blocks: ALL-OF { } { } { } and ANY-OF { } { } { }.

source: No Person ... he
lost: 'He' is a variable bound by 'no person'; NAMED on an unquantified 'person' inside IF does not say the handle ranges over every person.
fix: State that NAMED after a quantified phrase binds a variable for the rest of the sentence (ALL person NAMED P).

source: been seven Years a citizen
lost: Duration has no role; 'WHEN 7 year' can be read as 'at year seven' or 'seven years ago', and 'at least' is absent.
fix: Role SPAN, plus bound particles LEAST / MOST before a number (SPAN LEAST 7 year).

source: shall not have attained ... when elected ... shall be chosen
lost: The reference times (age and citizenship judged at one moment, residence at election) are relative to a future event, but only absolute PAST/FUTURE exist.
fix: Relative-time particles BEFORE / AFTER inside blocks.

source: advances ... avenues ... people ... systems ... latencies
lost: Plural is unmarked, so 'an advance has enabled a new avenue for a person' is an equally good decoding.
fix: Add quantifier PLURAL (more than one, number unstated); bare head = number unspecified.

source: due to neurological illness or injury
lost: A two-noun 'or' forces the whole relative clause to be written twice inside an OR block.
fix: Phrase-level OR: CAUSE (illness OR injury) KIND nerve.

source: These systems can decode
lost: Ability 'can' needs a content predicate 'capable' wrapped around the real clause, with the agent repeated.
fix: CAN in the modality slot.

source: currently comes at the cost
lost: Unmarked time means 'now or timeless', so 'at present, and this may change' cannot be separated from a standing truth without an added WHEN now.
fix: Add time particle NOW (present, as opposed to unmarked timeless).

source: have enabled
lost: Present perfect (a past development whose effect holds now) is the same as a finished past event.
fix: Define DONE without PAST as 'result holds now', and document the contrast with PAST DONE.

source: limiting communication throughput and preventing users
lost: A sentence can carry only one relation with one target, so 'a second result of 5, added to 6' cannot be said; I had to pick RESULT and drop ADD.
fix: Allow the relation slot to repeat and to take several labels (RESULT 5 ADD 6).

source: highly variable and disruptive ... high decoding accuracy ... major bottleneck
lost: 'Highly' is dropped, and graded properties can only be modifier roots with no scale.
fix: Degree particles before a modifier (KIND VERY variable).

source: Recent advances ... have enabled / These systems can
lost: The authors' own claims fit none of the openers: not shown in context (GIVEN), not derived, not mere background memory; RECALLED undersells and GIVEN misstates the source.
fix: Opener TELL / CLAIM for the writer's own assertion.

source: I was hopeful, and I've tried
lost: 'Was' (no longer so) against 'have tried' (up to this moment) both come out as PAST; the 'until now' meaning is gone.
fix: Phase particles (STILL, NO-LONGER) and DONE-without-PAST defined as 'up to now'.

source: see if this long thread results in anything constructive
lost: An embedded yes/no question has no form; it must be spelled as OR { p } { NOT p }, writing the clause twice.
fix: Add block prefix WHETHER (embedded yes/no question).

source: this seems to be going backwards
lost: 'Seems' (judged from appearances) is merged into LIKELY, which states a probability and not the basis for it.
fix: Add strength/evidence value APPARENT, or allow GIVEN + LIKELY to be documented as 'seems'.

source: (or at least not forwards)
lost: The retreat to a weaker claim ('if not that, then at minimum this') becomes a symmetric either/or.
fix: Add relation WEAKEN (this sentence is the fallback claim if the target is too strong), or bound particle LEAST usable on clauses.

source: DID NOT TOUCH THE DMA LAYER AT ALL ... complete garbage arguments
lost: Anger and contempt have no attitude marker; EMPHASIS conveys force but the decoded text is calm, and there is only one level of emphasis.
fix: Add attitudes ANGER (or DISAPPROVE) and allow EMPHASIS to be doubled for strong emphasis.

source: It was literally just another user of it
lost: 'Just a user, nothing more' limits the predicate, but ONLY may stand only before a phrase, so the predicate must be turned into a noun phrase under a dummy 'equal'.
fix: Allow focus particles before the predicate as well as before phrases.

source: completely separate ... complete garbage
lost: Maximal degree ('entirely') is dropped or pushed into a content modifier.
fix: Degree particle FULLY (maximal), with BARELY and VERY.

source: in _any_ way, shape, or form
lost: The piled-up triple is reduced to 'in no way'; the claim is intact, only the rhetorical hammering is gone.
fix: none: out of scope

source: you keep bringing up
lost: 'Keep doing' (persisting despite objection) is only HABIT, which says it is regular, not that it annoyingly continues.
fix: Phase particle STILL (continuing), combinable with HABIT or ONGOING.

source: what you have been doing is basically saying "..."
lost: 'Basically' marks the quotation as the writer's paraphrase of the other person's stance; the encoding says the person literally said it.
fix: Approximator ROUGHLY before a predicate ('amounts to'), and a distinction between QUOTE (verbatim) and a paraphrase block.

source: Honestly,
lost: A comment on the speaker's own manner of speaking (frankly) has no place; EMPHASIS is the nearest thing.
fix: Add attitude FRANK (speaker flags bluntness).

source: as a DMA maintainer I control
lost: 'In the capacity of' is rewritten as a cause clause ('because you maintain it'), which is close but claims a causal link the source leaves as a role.
fix: Role AS.

source: that is not how *any* of this works
lost: NOT with ALL would be ambiguous between 'not all of it' and 'none of it'; I had to restate with NO, and the loose 'this' (the whole situation) needed an invented noun.
fix: Fix a rule that NOT outscopes quantifiers in its clause, and add a demonstrative head THIS for the situation at hand.

source: I could not stop for Death
lost: Inability needs the content predicate 'capable' wrapped round the clause; 'could not' and 'did not' are otherwise the same.
fix: CAN in the modality slot (NOT PAST CAN stop).

source: Death, He ... Immortality
lost: Death and Immortality are treated as persons (capital, 'He'); a handle on the root 'death' does not say the abstraction is a character.
fix: Allow name«» to wrap a native root to make it a proper name (name death), marking personification.

source: held but just ourselves And Immortality
lost: ONLY must scope over a three-member list, but there is no list; the workaround is an invented 'group' with three membership clauses.
fix: Phrase-level AND, with focus particles scoping over the whole joined phrase: THEME ONLY (ME AND D AND immortality).

source: The carriage
lost: The definite article on a first mention (a carriage the reader is expected to accept as known, Death's carriage) cannot be distinguished from 'a carriage'.
fix: Add a phrase particle KNOWN (identifiable to the reader) or its opposite NEW.

source: We slowly drove
lost: Joint action by two has no form: there is no 'we' and WITH means manner or means, not company, so the drive is written as two separate drivings.
fix: Add role ALONG (companion), or phrase-level AND for a joint AGENT.

source: And I had put away
lost: The putting-away happened before the drive; PAST DONE marks completion but not that it precedes the events just told.
fix: Relative-time particle BEFORE in the time slot (PAST BEFORE DONE).

source: For his civility
lost: 'In return for / in answer to' sits between CAUSE (reason) and FOR (purpose) and neither says exchange.
fix: Add role AGAINST/EXCHANGE (thing given in return), or document CAUSE as covering motive.

source: He kindly stopped for me
lost: The courtesy vocabulary applied to dying is ironic or eerie; the encoding reports plain kindness.
fix: IRONY attitude.

source: We slowly drove, he knew no haste, And I had put away / My labor, and my leisure too
lost: Meter, line breaks, the labor/leisure alliteration and the run-on clauses without connectives are gone.
fix: none: out of scope

summary: The most frequent gap is degree: there is no way to say very, so, hardly, completely, highly or 'how much', and sentence-wide EMPHASIS is a poor substitute. Next is the lack of any joining of phrases or more than two clauses (and/or lists), which forced me to duplicate whole sentences or invent 'group' nouns, and once made ONLY unable to scope over a list. Third, everything that lives in the sentence header (opener, relation, strength, attitude) is unavailable inside { }, so quoted speech, embedded questions and reasons given by a quoted speaker lose their marking, and embedded WHAT is ambiguous with a real question. Modality (must, can, shall), relative time (had done, just, at last, currently, for seven years) and several missing roles (about, as, duration, companion, in-exchange) recur across every genre, and the opener set has no home for fiction, law-making, expressive acts or a writer's own plain assertion. I used role particles, KIND/OF, relative clauses with SELF, NAMED handles, STEP, the relations ADD/RESULT/CONCEDE/BACKGROUND and the ONLY/ALSO focus particles constantly; I never used DERIVED, ASSUMED, PLAN, REQUEST, DEFINE, EXAMPLE, SEQUENCE, POLITE, EVEN, THAN beyond one case, or any of the logic section (EACH, WHILE, RETURN, slots).
